description: My grandma is required to take two medicines Z1 and D3 everyday. She needs to take at least 5 grams of Z1 and 10 grams of D3 everyday. These medicines are available in two pills named Zodiac and Sunny. One pill of Zodiac contains 1.3 grams of Z1 while one pill of Sunny contains 1.2 grams of Z1. On the other hand, one pill of Zodiac contains 1.5 grams of D3 and one pill of Sunny contains 5 grams of D3. The cost per pill of Zodiac is $1 and the cost per pill of Sunny is $3. Formulate a LP such that the medicine requirement can be fulfilled at the lowest cost.

RequiredZ1.definition: Minimum required daily amount of medicine Z1 in grams

RequiredD3.definition: Minimum required daily amount of medicine D3 in grams

Z1PerZodiac.definition: Amount of medicine Z1 in grams per pill of Zodiac

Z1PerSunny.definition: Amount of medicine Z1 in grams per pill of Sunny

D3PerZodiac.definition: Amount of medicine D3 in grams per pill of Zodiac

D3PerSunny.definition: Amount of medicine D3 in grams per pill of Sunny

CostZodiac.definition: Cost per pill of Zodiac in dollars

CostSunny.definition: Cost per pill of Sunny in dollars

objective.description: "Minimize the total daily cost of purchasing Zodiac and Sunny pills while meeting the required amounts of medicines Z1 and D3"

constraints.description: 1.3 * (number of Zodiac pills) + 1.2 * (number of Sunny pills) >= RequiredZ1
1.5 * (number of Zodiac pills) + 5 * (number of Sunny pills) >= RequiredD3

ZodiacPills.definition: Number of Zodiac pills taken per day

SunnyPills.definition: Number of Sunny pills taken per day
